summary: Three proofs close their essential step by undocumented definitional equality (`change` across `Additive`/`Multiplicative` wrappers, a bare `congr 1` through `Algebra.TensorProduct.map`, and `convert ... <;> rfl` patching `AlgHom.id.comp AlgHom.id`), in each case where an explicit lemma already in the PR or in Mathlib would do the job. A fourth `change` unfolds a reducible-`abbrev` chain and will break silently if `baseChange` stops being an `abbrev`.
